collection.description: The collection (an index on Pinecone, a class on Weaviate). vector_list_collections lists them.

namespace.description: Pinecone: the namespace (empty: the default one). Weaviate: the tenant of a multi-tenant collection. Milvus: the partition. Not used by Qdrant and Chroma.

items.description: A record id: text, or an integer where the store's ids are integers (Qdrant, Milvus with Int64 keys).

ids.description: The records to delete. A person approves the exact ids; nothing else is deleted.

note.description: Why you need this change. Shown to the approver as unverified.
